title: Uprooted
author: Naomi Novik
summary: Every ten years, a wizard known as the Dragon takes a girl from a valley village to live in his tower, and everyone expects it will be her best friend. It is not, and she finds she has her own kind of magic, while a corrupted forest spreads.
readIf: you like a folk-tale feel, grumpy wizards, strong magic and a creeping forest that is truly dangerous.
skipIf: you want a gentle, cosy read, as the Wood is frightening and the plot gets violent.

pairings.reason: Same author, another folk-tale reimagining with a clever, capable heroine at its centre.
Another atmospheric tale rooted in Slavic folklore with a quiet, strong heroine.
A lighter, funnier fantasy with a cranky wizard and a determined girl.
